posts.body:
Hi everyone,
I'm a complete beginner on RPG Maker VX Ace and have also just joined this forum (apologies if I'm posting in the wrong place / repeating content).
I'm producing a game for one of my assignments in university and I need to know if variables will stay at the same count if the game is saved. E.g. If POINTS+1 is given through dialogue, and then the player saves and reopens the game, will POINTS still remain at 1?
Sorry if this is a really stupid question, I'm unsure of how to test it myself.
Thanks so much!

Not a stupid question, you just don't know what the engine can do and literally does.
Answer: yes the value is saved. Most data that is created by the system is saved by default.
Switches & variables are saved by default in the save file.
Now, Welcome to the community. ensure you read the forum rules.
There are tutorial example games you can even download and play to learn more.
